identity_evidence.quote: We present a young lady of HGT-AdCC of right parotid gland

attribution_limitations: The Fig. 2 caption describes the imaging in a 26-year-old female patient, whereas the case text and Table 2 give the age as 28 years. A different number is a source conflict, not a print artefact; both ages are kept review-only.
The cytology differential is stated as PLGA, papillary cystic acinic cell carcinoma or AdCC; the source does not say which was favored.
The Fig. 3 caption describes p53 in the low grade components as weakly positive/negative, whereas Table 1 prints weak positivity for the low-grade area. The caption pair is kept review_only.
The Fig. 3 caption prints Ki67 labelling index 70% in the high grade component while Table 1 prints 65–70%; the two statements are kept as separate items.

The discussion states that the perineural spread in this case was seen at both levels, but the preceding sentence prints the levels as macroscopic or macroscopic, so which two levels are meant is not legible in the source.
